_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
O motshameki {player_id} mo papading ya LinesOfAction.
Mabole a gago ke '{side}', mabole a mmotsheki ke '{other}'.
Tsela ya tsamaya: `[b1b3]` (koordinete ya motswedi le koordinete ya bokhutlo). Tsamaya e e siameng e tsamaya ka mokgwa wa tlhogo, wa tshimologo, kgotsa wa diagonal ka palo ya mabole (mabole a mofuta ope) mo mokgweng oo. O ka tshwara mabole a gago, mme o se ka wa tshwara mabole a mmotsheki; go goroga mo mmotshekeng o a mo tshwara.  O wina fa mabole a gago a kgatlhanong.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego e tshwanetse go nna e2e4 (go tswa,go ya kwa dilekanyetsong).
invalid_move.no_piece: Ga go na {side} karolo mo go {coord}.
invalid_move.identical: Motswedi le kwa o yang teng di a tshwana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Go tsamaya go tshwanetse ga nna ka tlhamalalo kana ka tsela e e sekameng.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: E tshwanetse go tsamaya sekgala se se lekanang le sa dikarolwana tse di mo moleng.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Setshwantsho sa mmaba se thibile tsela.
invalid_move.destination_own: Lefelo le o yang kwa go lone ke la gago.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} o ile a tsamaya {from} -> {to} a tsaya mosidi wa setlhopha se sengwe.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Ditsamaya tse 60 tse di sa tshwarang mole.
outcome.draw_repetition: Boemo bo ne jwa ipoeletsa gararo.
